body:
Pets and Farm Update, stage 6 (farm). Answer (Karolis, 30 Oct):
1. Nobody owns a horse. The farm has 10 horses.
2. One rider per horse. A player takes a horse; others share the rest or wait until a rider brings one back to the stable.
3. You can ride only after a riding lesson. A horse instructor (new character) gives the lesson.
Horse model: https://claude.ai/artifact/6VamW3iTDycZZjZnfTrZa3#living-1

comments.text: Decisions chat: recorded as approved, Karolis answered in chat on 30 Oct.

title: Horse riding: 10 shared farm horses, one rider each, lesson first
